visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Letter a Is Not Counted
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Education has 5 vowels, but the program counts only 4 because the letter a is missed.

solution.explanation: indexOf returns the position of the character, and the position of 'a' in "aeiou" is 0. Testing > 0 treats position 0 as "not found", so only -1 should mean "not found": the test is >= 0.
